prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no test produced a statistically significant win.
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) harms performance, with 3 tests agreeing after noise correction (-3.5% overall).
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) negatively impacts performance, with 2 tests agreeing after noise correction (-2.4% overall).
Adoption redesigns, new adoption flows, and path selection redesigns showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for new home flows (home, new_flow) as only 1 test has been run.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to the actual measured results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -1.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -1.3% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: -0.1% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -3.5% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +2.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Interactive Carousel Redesign: Redesign the pick friend screen into a interactive carousel layout highlighting companion personalities and desktop animations. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9%, indicating users need a more engaging pet selection experience.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Compact Overview Redesign: Redesign the intro story screen into a compact layout with brief story cards detailing what pets do on the desktop. (why: The choose_path stage suffers from a high mean completion time of 514s, suggesting users get stuck reading early story screens.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Style Selection Screen: Insert a new style selection screen in the adoption flow to let users pick visual artistic styles for their pet. (why: Support receives multiple emails (3) about custom pet generation failing or rendering unexpected visual results.)
3: [home, new_flow] Background Waiting Experience Interactive Flow: Rebuild the waiting screen into an interactive flow featuring desktop tips, progress updates, and completion alerts. (why: The waiting phase on home has a high median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, leaving users unsure if generation is active.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Account Sync Clarification Copy: Add clear copy explaining that signing in saves your companion progress and prevents pet loss on restart. (why: 8 support emails (the top support issue) report pets missing or resetting after signing back into the application.)
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Lighting Tip Callout: Display a helpful hint on the photo upload screen recommending well-lit subject photos. (why: 3 support tickets report custom pet creation failures or visual distortion.)
6: [finish, hint] Home Intro Pet Controls Quick Hint: Add a clear hint on the final home intro screen explaining how to summon, move, or minimize the pet from the taskbar tray. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion after onboarding about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet.)
7: [choose_path, incentive] Path Options Bonus Animation Badge: Add playful feature badges to each path option on the path selection screen. (why: Conversion at choose_path drops to 76.2% with a very high mean duration of 514s.)
8: [adoption, wait_info] Adoption Certificate Time Estimate Notice: Show an estimated setup duration indicator on the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption has the longest median step duration (89s) and lowest completion rate (60.9%).)
9: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Trouble Notification Assistance: Trigger a helpful tip notification if a user spends more than 15 seconds on the sign-in screen. (why: Support noted issues where sign-in stalls or fails (2 emails), and mean sign-in time is 567s.)
